## Main Orchestrator — AI Agent Factory
POST /webhook/ai-factory/start with {mode: full|module|existing, requirement, module_name?, project_name?, models?, existing_zip_base64?}.

Pipeline: PM → (BA ∥ UI/UX) → (FE Architect ∥ BE Architect) → Code Generation (devs ∥ → Integration → store) → QA & Review → fix loop (max 2 extra rounds) → ZIP.
Sub-workflows are called over their webhooks — **activate all 6 workflows** and create the no n8n credentials are needed — provider keys come from the environment (.env), and all data is stored in MongoDB via the Code Execution Service.
